rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: On 11 November 2024 the House of Representatives' first ballot for the designation gave no majority: of 465 votes (majority 233), 石破茂 221, 野田佳彦 151, 馬場伸幸 38, 玉木雄一郎 28, 山本太郎 9, 田村智子 8, 吉良州司 4, 神谷宗幣 3 and 河村たかし 3; the Speaker ordered a runoff between 石破茂 and 野田佳彦 under House rule 18(3) and recessed at 15:03.

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: In the runoff after reopening at 15:36 on 11 November 2024, the House of Representatives designated 石破茂: of 465 votes, 石破茂 221 and 野田佳彦 160, with 84 votes for other names invalid; declared under House rule 18(3). The sitting adjourned at 16:11.

bounded_scope: Head-of-government observations for CLAUDE-C01-13 only (stacked on CLAUDE-C01-12). Each House's designation vote, any joint committee and the House of Representatives' prevailing resolution, the Imperial appointment ceremony, Kantei statements and accounts, the Official Gazette's appointment and loss-of-office notices, the Cabinet's minutes, a cabinet's formation, its resignation en masse, any continued performance of duties and acting designations stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. A null holder_name means the source names no holder of this role: an unnamed statement or schedule row, a House of Councillors designee who never held the office, or a designation of acting ministers.
